description: This file defines immutable list and dictionary classes for use with PyTorch's FX module, including functions for flattening and unflattening these collections for PyTree operations, and registers them as PyTree nodes.

classes.name: immutable_list
classes.description: An immutable version of list that disallows mutation and supports hashing.

classes.name: immutable_dict
classes.description: An immutable version of dict that disallows mutation and supports hashing.

methods.name: _no_mutation
methods.description: Raises a TypeError to prevent mutation of immutable collections.

methods.name: _immutable_list_flatten
methods.description: Flattens an immutable_list for PyTree operations.

methods.name: _immutable_list_unflatten
methods.description: Unflattens values into an immutable_list for PyTree operations.

methods.name: _immutable_dict_flatten
methods.description: Flattens an immutable_dict for PyTree operations.

methods.name: _immutable_dict_unflatten
methods.description: Unflattens values into an immutable_dict for PyTree operations.
